verdict.rationale: Docs show phone number provisioning (BYOT SIP trunking, provider integrations), API-driven outbound calling with a quickstart that places a call and fetches transcripts, and marketing/CLI evidence of inbound+outbound call handling at scale, all through the Bolna API/CLI. Missing for 10: explicit inbound phone-number purchase/provisioning API endpoint docs and independent third-party corroboration of scale claims.
